display.purpose: The single largest text in the app — the wordmark on the login screen only.

headline.purpose: A screen's primary question or title, e.g. the onboarding prompt.

title.purpose: Tab-screen headers (Hoy, Salud, Perfil) — Medium weight, a location marker not an announcement.

body.purpose: Standard reading text, subtitles, secondary/ghost button labels.

label.purpose: Uppercase field labels above form inputs.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Deliberate: measured at 1.03:1 over Polar Night, weaker than the palette's weakest tonal step (1.11:1). Depth is tonal, and grouping is an outline. See The Flat-By-Default Rule.

motion.name: status-icon-in
motion.purpose: A button's check or alert arriving. Skipped entirely under the system remove-animations setting; the icon still appears.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast entry, falling back to a fade under reduced motion.

motion.name: toast-out
motion.purpose: Toast exit, falling back to a fade under reduced motion.

motion.name: confetti-fall
motion.purpose: The one-shot registration celebration. Renders nothing at all under the system remove-animations setting, because confetti carries no information to preserve.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width primary action. Ice Blue Glacial fill, dark text, 12px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; background: #a5f2f3; color: #0b1120; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a5f2f3; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action (retry, sign out). Transparent fill, Steel Frost border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: transparent; color: #cbd5e1; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #a5f2f3; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a5f2f3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link Button (tertiary)
components.description: Lowest-emphasis action: no border, no fill, sized to its text. Uses Aqua Glaciar so it never claims the primary accent's meaning.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-link"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="#7dd3e8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5v14"/></svg>Añadir salud y actividad</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 0; background: none; border: none; color: #7dd3e8; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-link:hover { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Fjord Slate fill, hairline border, muted placeholder.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #131c2e; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 12px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #a5f2f3; } .ds-input[aria-invalid] { border-color: #ef4444; }

components.name: Selector Chip
components.description: Exclusive single-select option within a small fixed set (sex, activity level). Unselected state.
components.css: .ds-chip { flex: 1; text-align: center; background: #131c2e; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; padding: 12px 0; border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #334155; }

components.name: Selector Chip (Active)
components.description: Selected state of the same chip — Elevated Frost fill, accent border.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { flex: 1; text-align: center; background: #1e293b; color: #f1f5f9; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; padding: 12px 0; border: 1px solid #a5f2f3; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A voluntary boolean flag, unchecked by default. 6px radius is the one recorded exception to The One Radius Rule: 12px on a 24px box is a circle and reads as a radio button.
components.css: .ds-check { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-check-box { flex: none; width: 24px; height: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #a5f2f3; border: 1px solid #a5f2f3; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-check-label { color: #f1f5f9; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; }

components.name: Toast (success)
components.description: Transient message above the whole app, in success/warning/error/info. Elevated Frost fill with a status-coloured border and no shadow; the draining bar shows an auto-hide is coming. A persistent variant drops the bar and offers an action instead.
components.html: Loki ya está en la app.
components.css: .ds-toast { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #22c55e; border-radius: 12px; background: #1e293b; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toast-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; } .ds-toast-msg { flex: 1; color: #f1f5f9; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-toast-bar { height: 2px; width: 62%; background: #22c55e; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: 3-destination bottom navigation. Deep Ice background, active label in Ice Blue Glacial.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: flex; background: #0d1525; border-top: 1px solid #1e293b; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; background: none; border: none; color: #64748b; font-family: 'Outfit', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 8px 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab--active { color: #a5f2f3; }

narrative.overview:
Petlife runs dark-mode-only, deep navy fading toward black, cut through by a single ice-blue accent used sparingly. The personality is cold, precise, and minimal: no shadows, no gradients, no decoration that isn't load-bearing. Every screen so far is a plain vertical stack — a title, a short set of fields, one primary action — because the product's own principle is low-friction retrospective logging, not a showcase interface. Depth comes entirely from tone (four fixed surface steps, darkest to lightest), never from a shadow.

Within that cold restraint, interactive elements are tactile and confident rather than timid: a filled ice-blue button, a visibly elevated selected state on chips, a full-width primary action that's unmissable. The coldness is in the palette and the absence of ornament; the confidence is in how directly each control commits to its state.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-mode-only, one accent hue (ice blue), used almost exclusively on primary actions and active states.
Flat by construction — tonal layering substitutes for shadows everywhere.
One typeface (Outfit) carries every role; hierarchy is built from weight and size, never a second font.
One corner radius (12px) on every interactive control, no exceptions yet.

Android is the primary adaptation target — the app ships to and is used on Android, so layout answers to Android insets (status bar, system navigation bar or gesture inset, back-gesture edges, the Android density range). The browser is the development and review harness and a secondary export.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ice Blue Glacial is the only color that means "act here." It appears on the primary button, the active tab, and a selected chip's border — nowhere else.

rules.name: The Text-On-Accent Rule
rules.body: Any text placed on an Ice Blue Glacial surface uses on-accent (#0B1120), never text-base — text-base is Tailwind's font-size utility, not a color.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Outfit is the only typeface. Reach for a heavier weight or larger size before considering a second family.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows, no glassmorphism, no blur. A component that needs to signal 'raised' moves up one tonal step instead.

rules.name: The One Radius Rule
rules.body: 12px is the only corner radius in the system. A new component defaults to it rather than picking a fresh value.

dos: Do use the single 12px radius (rounded-xl) on every new interactive control.
Do pair a confirmation with the action that triggered it: the primary action calls the animal, the success toast answers.
Do express state through a tonal step and the accent border, never a shadow.
Do keep Outfit as the only typeface; differentiate by weight and size.

Do use text-on-accent for any text on an Ice Blue Glacial surface — never text-base. The rule extends to status fills: #0B1120 on Error Red is 5.00:1 and passes AA, while the light text is 3.44:1 and fails.
Do resolve every color through a Nordic Ice token; a raw hex value in a component className is a defect.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glassmorphism, or blur.
Don't introduce a second accent hue outside Ice Blue Glacial / Aqua Glaciar.

Don't communicate state by color alone - pair it with a non-chromatic cue. A selected chip's fill against an unselected chip's measures 1.16:1, so the selected label is set to 700 weight; the accent border alone is not enough.
Don't write a sentence where an intuitive control would do; explanatory text the average reader skips is clutter, and extra detail should be reachable rather than in everyone's way.
Don't explain a collapsed or inactive block from the outside — that is cognitive load charged to every reader, including the majority who never open it.
Don't state what the context already carries.
Don't let the warm voice reach an error — a failure must be unambiguous before it is friendly.
Don't put the voice in a label; structural text stays literal.

Don't reach for platform-native components (Material 3 FABs, Material filled text fields, Android date-picker dialogs) to satisfy per-OS conformance. Being an Android app does not make Material 3 the house style.
